At VREY, we're building the EnergyOS for multi-family buildings.

Germany has over 3.3 million apartment buildings — and they are the blind spot of the energy transition. <1% solar penetration. <2% smart metering. Almost no flexibility or intelligent energy management.

At the same time, regulation is forcing property owners into major investment: solar is becoming mandatory, smart meters must be rolled out nationwide within five years, heating and mobility are electrifying. The apartment building is transforming from passive real estate into an active part of the decentralised energy infrastructure.

What's missing is an integrated system that makes this transition economically viable and operationally manageable.

VREY combines certified meter operation with proprietary software, enabling property owners to sell self-generated solar power directly to their tenants — simply, and without having to become an energy supplier themselves (§42b EnWG). Regulatory obligation becomes a profitable, predictable opportunity:

  • Double-digit returns and asset appreciation for owners,

  • ~20% electricity cost savings for tenants, and

  • digital infrastructure for storage, heat pumps, and flexibility.

We already manage a three-digit number of projects — including some of Germany's largest property holders and housing cooperatives — in all 16 federal states. In the course of our seed financing, we raised €3.3M from leading impact and energy VCs (including Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, and Kopa Ventures). We're now entering the next growth phase and expanding our team.

We're at the beginning of a structural market shift. Join us and help build the leading EnergyOS.

Your Profile

  • You have 2+ years of professional experience building and running full-stack web applications, ideally with Ruby on Rails. Experience in comparable frameworks (Django, Laravel, Spring Boot, NextJS) will also be considered, if you are truly motivated to learn and work with Rails.

  • You have a strong understanding and hands-on experience designing and optimizing relational database schemas (we use PostgreSQL).

  • You are used to working with APIs and integrating with 3rd-party services.

  • You have solid experience setting up and maintaining cloud/server infrastructure. We have a basic Heroku setup and Github CI/CD and need to gradually scale and improve monitoring etc.

  • You have at least basic frontend development skills, ideally with solid fundamentals (HTML, CSS and JavaScript), as well as familiarity with both the Rails way (Hotwire, Turbo and Stimulus) and a framework like React or Vue.

  • You are actively working with AI and pushing for efficient agentic setups; we are establishing Claude Code in the team and the whole company.

  • You like to take ownership for the features and components you work on and you are proactive in the product development.

  • You are excited about startups and want to make a real impact on the product and the company in a truely agile way.

  • You are based in Berlin (or willing to relocate). You will enjoy working in our office in Friedrichshain with the team most of the time, with the flexibility of 1-2 remote work days a week.

  • You are willing to learn energy industry terms in English and German and being comfortable with some parts of the company operating mostly in German. (Team language is English.)

  • Nice to have: You have experience working with multi-tenancy systems and/or are experienced with payment provider integration (e.g., Stripe Connect)

You will be an early member of our growing product development team, working across the entire stack.

The core functionality of the VREY platform is processing smart meter measurement data for analyzing and billing solar power usage. For this purpose, we provide landlords and tenants with a portal and automate contract management, invoicing and payment flows. An admin interface and integration with internal tools enable the creation and management of projects by our operations team.

  • You ensure that our features perform well for a growing number of users.

  • You co-own the development of our crucial backend processes: importing and processing of smart meter measurement data and automated billing.

  • You help designing and maintaining the underlying server infrastructure.

  • You instrument, optimize and monitor critical processes so they remain fast, reliable and dependable as we scale.

3. Technical design, architecture and engineering excellence

  • You research, evaluate and design technical solutions to new problems together with the team.

  • You contribute to our aspiration to get better and more efficient as engineers and as a team every day.

  • You continuously improve our development environment and engineering processes, including adopting the right tools, workflows and AI-powered development practices.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary including shares based on the level of your experience.

  • Real ownership: You shape VREY actively from day one. Ownership means responsibility for your tasks end-to-end and the opportunity to take leadership.

  • Visible impact: We ship features every day that make a difference for our customers and colleagues.

  • Personal and professional growth: We have very skilled and experienced people on the team that you can learn from and we actively provide opportunities to develop your career.

  • Making a difference: Our daily work reduces energy costs for tenants, advances the energy transition in residential buildings, and accelerates the economic decarbonisation of Germany's housing stock.

  • Great workplace: Office in a cool co-working space in Berlin-Friedrichshain, with free drinks, cerials, fruits, and plenty of lunch options nearby.

We're a team that shares lunch, swaps ideas, welcomes new faces regularly, and genuinely listens — come help shape what comes next.

At VREY, we believe that diversity strengthens both our company and society. We do not make hiring or employment decisions based on race, religion, ethnicity, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or age.

Even if you don't meet every requirement, don't hesitate to apply. If you're excited about our mission and believe you can contribute, we want to hear from you!

VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).

Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:

  • Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,

  • ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und

  • digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.

Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.

Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.

Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen und setzt klare Prioritäten mit Blick auf Impact, Skalierbarkeit und langfristigen Unternehmenserfolg

  • Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Start-ups, Energie oder Immobilien mit

  • Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) – unser Büro ist unser Homebase

  • Du sprichst Deutsch fließend (C2) und kannst komplexe Produkte verständlich erklären

Deine Aufgaben

Mission der Rolle

Du arbeitest eng mit Konrad (Head of Growth) zusammen und übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau eines der wichtigsten GTM-Units unseres Unternehmens.

Dein Ziel: Strukturen, Prozesse und Initiativen zu entwickeln, die es uns ermöglichen, die Energiewende in Mehrfamilienhäusern deutschlandweit schnell und skalierbar umzusetzen.   • Du bist einer der Key Hires für unser Business Development Team und arbeitest mit externen Stakeholdern zusammen, um den neuen Kanal effizient und reproduzierbar zu machen

  • Du übernimmst Ownership für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung eines skalierbaren Partner- und Projektkanals

  • Du denkst nicht in einzelnen Partnerschaften, sondern in skalierbaren Systemen

2. Business Development & kommerzielle Exzellenz

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Growth, Sales und dem CEO zusammen, um fortlaufend GTM-Hypothesen zu testen und erfolgreiche Modelle schnell zu skalieren

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Pipeline, Abschlüsse und Umsatzbeiträge

  • Du bringst Ideen ein, testest diese Hands-on und hast einen starken Fokus auf Execution

3. Ownership für GTM und Revenue Operations

  • Du nutzt die Learnings für den Aufbau von weiteren Business-Units in der Zukunft

  • Du entwickelst und verantwortest RevOps Prozesse, die mit unserem Wachstum mithalten

  • Du baust einfache, effektive Strukturen (z. B. CRM, Reporting, Automatisierungen), die uns schneller und besser machen

 

Benefits

Vergütung: Kompetitives Gehalt und Anteile am Unternehmen

Startdatum: so bald wie möglich, unbefristet

Team & Benefits: Lustiges Team, Tech Budget von 2 Tsd.€, regelmäßige Team Events und Learning Lunches, Gratis Getränke, Deutschlandticket

Weitere Vorteile: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Getränke & Snacks, Personalverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, das Unternehmen von Grund auf mitzugestalten

Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für Unternehmertum und Start-ups. Bei uns entstehen keine endlosen Slide-Decks oder rein theoretische Modelle – wir bauen ein Unternehmen und machen tagtäglich einen großen Schritt nach vorne. Wenn du von Tag 1 an etwas Großem mitgestalten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

description:
Location: Remote / Berlin (regular video shoot days in Berlin) | Language Requirement: Fluent German & English | Employment Type: Part-Time or Working Student

At Deepslate, we are building Speech to Speech Voice AI models that sound and act indistinguishable from a human. And we believe everyone should be able to use it.

When it comes to text and images, giants like OpenAI and Google have already cracked the code. With video, Veo3, Sora and others are closing the gap rapidly. But with its endless languages, dialects, accents, subtle intonations, and speech melodies voice remains a highly complex unsolved frontier.

That is exactly why we started Deepslate. Backed by top-tier investors from the Tech and AI sectors, as well as major German VC funds, we are incredibly well-funded and moving fast.

We are building the future of communication.

We aren't trying to build another standalone platform; instead, we are the intelligence engine powering countless other applications. Whether it's integrated as a module by a CRM provider, plugged into another Voice AI platform, or directly embedded into an enterprise system by our integration partners - our model is everywhere.

Your Role

Our model speaks for itself in every demo. But the people who should hear about it (enterprise decision-makers, platform builders, investors) don't spend their days in demos. They spend them on LinkedIn. Your mission is to build Deepslate's social media presence from the ground up and completely own it: the personal profiles of our two founders Paskal & Jan (CEO & CTO), built from zero, and our company page alongside them.

You won't start from zero on knowledge: We already have seven-figure impressions through personal profiles, and the learnings are documented. Product context, target audience, and content pillars are defined, and especially in the beginning you'll get intensive support from our growth team.

This is not an execution role with a finished playbook; it's a builder role with a strong foundation. The role is designed for part-time or working student capacity: We believe 15 to 20 focused hours with real ownership beat a full-time checklist. We'll define the exact scope and priorities together based on your availability.

Give Deepslate a Voice on LinkedIn

You'll turn our founders' knowledge and our customers' real stories into content that keeps enterprises and investors warm over months, and make a complex technology feel tangible, credible, and worth following.

  • Build & Own: Take complete ownership of our LinkedIn presence: positioning, content strategy, editorial planning, every single post, the approval workflow, and reporting. From zero to a channel that matters.

  • Founder Ghostwriting: Turn short conversations and voice memos into posts that sound like our founders, not like marketing. Founder content runs primarily in English.

  • Short-Form Video: Produce clips and story formats from real customer projects, founder insights, and product moments. We shoot together in Berlin.

  • Community: Comments, DMs, and genuine exchange with our B2B audience: contact centers, Voice AI platforms, and enterprise decision-makers.

Take Our Content Game to the Next Level:

  • Data-Driven Growth: Track reach, engagement, and inbound requests. Test hooks and formats systematically, build your own reporting, and let the numbers decide what gets scaled.

  • AI as Leverage: We're an AI company, internally too. Build an AI-assisted content workflow with us, from research to drafts to design, and keep pushing it further. Our goal is real leverage: more output, higher quality, faster learning loops.

  • Employee Advocacy: Help design the incentive program that gets our whole team posting on LinkedIn: templates, coaching, and a mechanism that turns the team into a reach multiplier.

What We're Looking For: Must-Haves:

  • Experience in social media management with a B2B / LinkedIn focus, ideally with examples or profiles we can look at (including your own).

  • Excellent writing in English and German: founder content is primarily in English, our audience is European.

  • An AI-first mindset: You already use AI tools (Claude & co.) daily and naturally in your content workflow, and you want to make AI your most important tool. Tell us how you work with it today.

  • A data-driven way of working: You make content decisions based on numbers, not gut feeling, and you change your mind when the data tells you to.

  • A founder-like mindset: You treat this channel like your own product. You'll get clear goals, a strong foundation, and sparring, but nobody assigns you tasks. You decide, prioritize, and deliver.

  • Availability of roughly 15 to 20 hours per week. If you join as a working student, you're enrolled at a university for the duration of the role.

  • Based in Berlin or nearby: We work remote-first, but meet regularly for video shoots and team days.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Ghostwriting experience or a visibly grown LinkedIn presence of your own.

  • A confident hand with short-form video editing (CapCut, Premiere & co.), or the drive to learn it fast.

  • Previous experience in a fast-paced Startup or DeepTech environment.

  • Experience building content workflows with AI tools or agents.

Deepslate is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, disability, age, or sexual orientation.

title: Marketing Working Student
description:
Marketing Working Student


Deine Mission

Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln.

trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen.

Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen.

Über trawa

trawa ist ein Scale-up mit Sitz in Berlin und rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, davon etwa 30 in Product & Tech. Bis heute haben wir mehr als 35 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, darunter eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde über 24 Millionen Euro im Mai 2025. Zu unseren Investoren zählen Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic und Tiny VC. Alle drei Gründer sind weiterhin aktiv dabei und zu 100 % committed, das Energieversorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft aufzubauen.

Wir suchen eine:n Werkstudent:in im Marketing für zwei zentrale Aufgaben: Du übernimmst unseren Energy Market Update – das regelmäßige Marktbriefing für unsere Kund:innen und Interessent:innen – und verfasst und optimierst Inhalte für Suchmaschinen. Dazu gehört auch, wie trawa in KI-Assistenten sichtbar wird.

Du berichtest direkt an unsere:n Content Marketing Manager:in und arbeitest bei Events eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen. Du gestaltest das Produkt mit, das die europäische Industrie wieder wettbewerbsfähiger macht – und setzt deine Ideen mit hohem Tempo um.

Die Position ist in Berlin angesiedelt. trawa ist ein Office-First-Unternehmen: In der Regel arbeitest du an fünf Tagen pro Woche aus unserem Büro.

Das Team

Du wirst Teil des trawa Marketing-Teams und unterstützt ein vielseitiges Aufgabenspektrum in den Bereichen Brand, Content, SEO, PR, Events und Paid Growth. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Inhalten, die Reichweite und Aufmerksamkeit schaffen, Menschen zur Interaktion bewegen und damit unser Geschäftswachstum unterstützen.

Wen wir suchen

Du schreibst sehr gut: Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Dichte regulatorische Entwicklungen kannst du so aufbereiten, dass Geschäftsführer:innen sie in drei Minuten verstehen.

Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben: Idealerweise studierst du Marketing, Kommunikation, BWL, Energiewirtschaft, Politikwissenschaft oder Volkswirtschaftslehre. Dein Studienfach ist für uns aber weniger wichtig als deine Arbeitsweise.

Du arbeitest zuverlässig und selbstständig: Das Energy Market Update erscheint nach einem festen Zeitplan. Deadlines sind bei uns verbindlich – und keine bloße Absichtserklärung.

Du interessierst dich für Energie: Vorkenntnisse im Energiemarkt sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Du wirst dir das Wissen bei uns schnell aneignen. Was wir dir nicht beibringen können, ist echtes Interesse am Thema.

Du interessierst dich für SEO: Du hast Lust, Inhalte für Suchmaschinen zu schreiben und bestehende Inhalte zu verbessern. Das Handwerk bringen wir dir bei – von der Keyword-Recherche über die Optimierung einzelner Seiten bis hin zur Frage, wie KI-Assistenten Inhalte aufgreifen. Was du mitbringst, ist die Neugier verstehen zu wollen, warum eine Seite gut rankt und eine andere nicht.

Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen

Nach sechs Wochen: Onboarding

  • Du verstehst trawas Produkt und die Grundlagen des deutschen Energiemarkts. Außerdem weißt du, wer in Marketing, Growth und Sales für welche Themen verantwortlich ist.

  • Du hast dein erstes Energy Market Update recherchiert und entworfen und gemeinsam mit deiner Führungskraft besprochen.

  • Du kennst unser Content-, SEO- und Reporting-Setup und kannst dich darin selbstständig orientieren.

  • Du hast mit Unterstützung eine bestehende Seite erstmals für Suchmaschinen optimiert.

Im dritten Monat: Ramp-up

  • Du verantwortest das trawa Energy Market Update ganzheitlich – von der Recherche über den Entwurf bis zur Veröffentlichung – und brauchst nur noch eine kurze abschließende Prüfung.

  • Du hast an Blog- und LinkedIn-Inhalten mitgearbeitet – von der Recherche bis zum fertigen Text.

  • Du verfasst und optimierst Inhalte für Suchmaschinen selbstständig und kannst anhand des Trackings nachvollziehen, welche Wirkung sie erzielen.

  • Du hast einen vollständigen Messezyklus unterstützt: von der Vorbereitung über Lead-Listen bis zur Nachverfolgung.

Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

  • Du fragst früh nach, statt zu raten. Wir beantworten eine Frage am Montag lieber, als am Freitag einen fertigen Text grundlegend überarbeiten zu müssen.

  • Du fühlst dich wohl mit Themen, die du zunächst noch nicht vollständig verstehst. Regulierungstexte sind schließlich für niemanden die erste Sprache.

  • Du hinterfragst deine eigenen Texte kritisch. Der erste Entwurf ist nie die finale Version.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, weil du ein wiederkehrendes Format parallel zu verschiedenen Projekten betreuen wirst.

Warum trawa?

Wirkung: Europäische KMU geben jährlich zwischen 150.000 und 10 Millionen Euro für Strom aus – viele davon zahlen zu viel und sind an veraltete Beschaffungsmodelle gebunden. Mit unserem Produkt veränderst du unmittelbar, wie Tausende Unternehmen Energie einkaufen, managen und nutzen. Die Wirkung ist messbar, der Markt ist riesig und der Zeitpunkt ist jetzt.

Die Position: Bereits ab der ersten Woche verantwortest du ein Format für unsere Kund:innen – von der Recherche über den Entwurf bis zur Veröffentlichung. Gleichzeitig schreibst du Inhalte für Suchmaschinen und siehst direkt, welche Wirkung deine Texte erzielen.

Verantwortung und Unterstützung: Du übernimmst echte Verantwortung für dein eigenes Format und arbeitest dabei mit einem erfahrenen Team zusammen, das deine Arbeit sorgfältig prüft und dir konkretes Feedback gibt, wie du sie weiter verbessern kannst.

Ownership: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und treibst Ergebnisse voran – unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund oder deiner bisherigen Berufserfahrung.

Lernen und Entwicklung: Wir stellen dir ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget und feste Zeit für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung zur Verfügung. Dich erwarten Mentoring, vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und echte Perspektiven für deinen nächsten Karriereschritt – einschließlich einer realistischen Möglichkeit, nach deinem Studium dauerhaft bei uns einzusteigen.

Vielfalt und Inklusion: Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt, und unser Team spiegelt das wider. Menschen aus mehr als 15 Nationen bringen unterschiedliche Sprachen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen. Bei trawa ist Familienfreundlichkeit auf allen Ebenen selbstverständlich – in unserem Team und in der Führung arbeiten Eltern. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem alle ihr Bestes geben können.

Vergütung und Benefits: Dich erwarten eine attraktive Vergütung, Zuschüsse für Internet und Mittagessen, eine Mitgliedschaft im Sport Club, feste Lerntage mit jährlichem Weiterbildungsbudget, ein wöchentliches Team-Mittagessen und regelmäßige Teamevents.

Bei trawa bauen wir einen vielfältigen, inklusiven und authentischen Arbeitsplatz auf. Wenn dich die Position begeistert, dein bisheriger Weg aber nicht in allen Punkten dem Anforderungsprofil entspricht, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht bist du genau die richtige Person für diese oder eine andere Position bei uns.

title: Senior/Staff Golang Engineer (EMEA)
description:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.

 

About the Role

We're building WunderGraph Cosmo, the open-source GraphQL Federation solution. Probably the most important component of Cosmo is the Cosmo Router, which - simply put - connects all API endpoints and handles the GraphQL requests and responses whilst applying the Federation protocol (among other magical things, like normalization, execution planning etc.). Fully written in Go, it's the fastest GraphQL Router available and a quite potent (and complex) piece of cutting-edge open-source software. How about joining our team to make it even better and strap the rocket boosters onto GraphQL Federation?

 

TEAM INTEGRATION

  • You align with the Product team and Customer Success teams for product feedback

  • You support and consult with the engineering team.

     

You will be in charge of

  • Develop, refactor and maintain GraphQL Go Tools' (Router) open-source code base in Golang (low GC code)

  • Work closely with your engineering team mates on new Router capabilities (e.g. Open Federation, new data sources)

  • Focus on performance, security and stability of the Router

  • Review Router telemetry to identify areas of improvement

  • Run internal penetration tests of the Router

  • Troubleshoot Router issues, potentially together with our customers' engineers

  • Analyze and accept up open-source contributions on Github

     

The "Engine" is essentially a Golang application which translates GraphQL requests into any other protocol, like OpenAPI, SOAP, gRPC, GraphQL, Apollo Federation, etc. You could consider the Engine as a "GraphQL Compiler" or Transpiler. The Engine is responsible for parsing, normalization, execution planning, execution runtime, etc... If you are interested in working with ASTs, AST transformations, etc... you will love this kind of work. We have performance requirements, so you should be proficient in writing performant and low GC code in Golang.

Some of your tasks will take more than a few weeks to complete, Ideally, you're someone who likes to go deep on one topic instead of going wide and shallow on many different topics.

 

Here's a list of things you might be working on:

  • Extend the Compiler "backend" to support Apollo Federation v2

  • Extend the Compiler "backend" to support gRPC

Product compliance is not a topic that makes people lean in at dinner parties. Most companies manage that wall with spreadsheets, inbox archaeology, and one very tired quality manager.

Nowhere is that wall higher than in Germany: the largest consumer market in Europe, home to the manufacturers and brands most exposed to tightening EU regulation, and a market that takes compliance more seriously than anyone. We're fixing this with AI, and we want you to be the person who brings it there.

title: Senior Video Producer
description:
About Platform Engineering

Platform Engineering (platformengineering.org) is home to the world's largest community of platform engineers. Through PlatformCon, one of the world's largest conferences dedicated to platform engineering, we bring together more than 50,000 engineers, technology leaders, and decision-makers every year to share ideas, showcase innovation, and shape the future of internal developer platforms.

Alongside our events, we publish research, run a university, and produce content that reaches hundreds of thousands of engineers worldwide. In practice, we're a media house for a technical audience.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Video Producer to own video across the organization, end to end.

This is a build-it role. We don't have a video function yet. What we have is freelancers, ambition, and an audience that already trusts us. You'll come in and create the system: how we shoot, how we edit, how we publish, and how our YouTube channel grows.

You'll own the craft and the pipeline. That means editing the bulk of our output yourself, but also deciding what camera our founders point at themselves, how their rooms are lit, how their audio is captured, and what "good" looks like before anyone hits record. It means owning our YouTube channel as a channel, with packaging, Shorts, retention, and growth all in scope, rather than treating it as a place to upload finished files.

We're a distributed team, so most of what we make is produced remotely. A few times a year we come together at offsites across Europe and beyond, and you'll turn those into concentrated production windows where we capture a quarter's worth of higher-production content in a few days.

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end video production: concept, shoot setup, edit, post, publish, and performance review.

  • Define and maintain our remote production standards for cameras, lenses, microphones, lighting, and backgrounds, and set up the team so a home office consistently produces broadcast-credible video.

  • Coach on-camera talent, including our founders, on framing, audio, pacing, and delivery, and hold the standard once it's set.

  • Edit the majority of our weekly output across long-form, interview, explainer, event, and short-form content.

  • Own our YouTube channel: packaging, thumbnails, titles, descriptions, chapters, SEO, and publishing cadence.

  • Build and run our Shorts strategy as a deliberate format, not as offcuts from long-form.

  • Analyze channel performance across retention, CTR, watch time, and subscriber growth, and use it to decide what we make next.

  • Plan and run quarterly production sprints at our in-person offsites, including shot lists, scheduling, and directing local crew where needed.

  • Capture and repurpose content from PlatformCon and our other events.

  • Build the systems behind all of this: intake and brief formats, turnaround expectations, asset libraries, templates, and brand kit.

  • Manage a bench of external animators, editors, and specialists for advanced motion work and high-volume weeks.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of professional experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for video production and post-production

  • Demonstrable ownership of video end to end. You've been the person responsible for the output, not one step in someone else's pipeline.

  • Expert-level editing skills in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut, with strong color and audio finishing.

  • Real command of production fundamentals: camera selection and settings, lens choice, lighting design, and audio capture, including how to get all of it right in a spare bedroom rather than a studio.

  • Genuine YouTube expertise. You understand how the algorithm actually rewards content, you've packaged videos that outperformed their baseline, and you can explain why a video underperformed beyond "the thumbnail was weak."

  • A track record with short-form: you know what makes a Short retain, and you've made them work as a format in their own right.

  • Systems thinking. You document what you build, and you'd rather fix a workflow once than fight it weekly.

  • Comfort directing people who aren't natural on-camera performers, tactfully and without losing the standard.

  • Experience briefing and managing freelancers or external production partners.

  • Native-level English proficiency.

  • Willingness to travel a few times per year for offsites and events.

Nice to have

  • Experience producing video for technical or developer audiences, and comfort with the subject matter.

  • Motion graphics and animation skills (After Effects or similar).

  • Experience growing a YouTube channel with numbers you can point to.

  • Podcast production and audio post experience.

  • Experience running multi-day batch shoots or studio days.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted editing and production tooling, and a practical view on where it helps.

  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up, and with remote, globally distributed teams.

Why join us?

You'd be the first video hire at an organization that already has the audience, the access, and the credibility, and no one shaping how any of it looks on screen. There's no existing system to inherit or work around. You define it.

You'll have direct access to the people building and running the world's most interesting internal developer platforms, and the freedom to decide how their stories get told. If you want a role where your judgment sets the standard rather than executes someone else's, this is that role.

Diese Rolle unterscheidet sich von einer klassischen GF-Rolle in einem unabhängigen Vermögensverwalter durch eines: Sie führen das Institut nicht alleine. Im Hintergrund steht eine Plattform, die Ihnen die Werkzeuge in die Hand gibt, die heute den Unterschied zwischen Stagnation und Wachstum ausmachen.

ThrivoOS — die Technologieinfrastruktur

Compliance-Automation, KI-gestützte Prozesse, modernes Reporting, digitale Mandantenkommunikation — eingebettet in das Institut, ohne Systemwechsel. Sie verbringen weniger Zeit mit operativer Last und mehr Zeit mit dem was zählt: Mandanten und Wachstum.

M&A-Unterstützung für Bolt-on-Akquisitionen

Wachstum durch Zukäufe ist für ein Institut alleine kaum stemmbar. Christopher Kraft und das Thrivo-Team identifizieren, strukturieren und begleiten Bolt-on-Akquisitionen für Sie — von der Erstansprache bis zum Closing. Sie konzentrieren sich auf die Integration, nicht auf die Transaktion.

Wachstumskapital

Thrivo stellt Kapital bereit für strategische Investitionen — neue Standorte, Teamerweiterungen, Technologieprojekte, Akquisitionen. Sie müssen Wachstum nicht aus dem Cashflow finanzieren.

Regulatorische Expertise & Bestellungsverfahren

FINMA-, BaFin- und FMA-Anforderungen werden komplexer. Thrivo unterstützt mit zentraler regulatorischer Expertise — bei laufenden Compliance-Themen, Auditprozessen und Inhaberkontrollverfahren ebenso wie bei Ihrer initialen Bestellung als Geschäftsführer. Die Koordination zwischen Inhaber, Aufsichtsbehörde und Ihnen läuft über uns.

Peer-Netzwerk

Sie sind nicht alleine. Sie werden Teil eines Kreises von Thrivo-Geschäftsführern, die vergleichbare Aufgaben in vergleichbaren Instituten verantworten — strukturierte Erfahrungsaustausche, gemeinsame Investitionsgrundlagen, geteilte Best Practices.

Profil

Etablierter unabhängiger Vermögensverwalter im DACH-Raum, in der Regel mit verwaltetem Vermögen zwischen CHF/EUR 150 Millionen und 1 Milliarde. Langjährig gewachsenes Mandantenbuch, klares Anlageprofil, stabile Margenstruktur. Häufig zwischen 5 und 20 Mitarbeitende. Inhaber typischerweise zwischen 55 und 70 Jahren.

Standort

Schweiz, Deutschland oder Österreich — abhängig vom konkreten Match. Standorte sind etabliert, mit eigenen Räumlichkeiten und gewachsener regionaler Verankerung.

Mandantenkreis

Vermögende Privatkunden, Unternehmer, Familien — Beziehungen die häufig über Jahrzehnte gewachsen sind. Diese Mandanten haben dem Inhaber persönlich vertraut. Sie bauen dieses Vertrauen schrittweise und mit Substanz weiter auf.

Wer wir suchen

Was Sie mitbringen

  • Mindestens 12 Jahre Erfahrung im Wealth Management — Private Banking, unabhängige Vermögensverwaltung, Family Office oder vergleichbare Umgebung — davon mindestens 3–5 Jahre in einer Leitungs- oder Geschäftsführungsfunktion

  • Persönliche Eignung für die Bestellung als Geschäftsführer einer regulierten Vermögensverwaltung — nachweisbare Leitungserfahrung, einwandfreie persönliche und berufliche Integrität, fachliche Qualifikation gemäss FINIG, WpIG oder vergleichbarem Rahmen

  • Praxiserprobtes Verständnis von Compliance, Risikomanagement und Mandantenschutz im regulierten Vermögensverwaltungskontext

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Führung von Mandantenbeziehungen auf Senior-Niveau, idealerweise mit eigenem AUM-Verantwortungsbereich

  • Bereitschaft und persönliche Reife, ein etabliertes Institut zu übernehmen — Respekt vor dem Aufgebauten, Geduld im Übergang, Mut zur Weiterentwicklung

  • Deutsch als Muttersprache oder verhandlungssicher; Englisch fliessend

Was uns zusätzlich interessiert

  • Eigene unternehmerische Erfahrung, sei es in einer Geschäftsführungsrolle oder als Mitgründer

  • Bestehendes persönliches Netzwerk in der DACH-Wealth-Management-Community

  • Erfahrung im Auf- oder Umbau von Beratungsteams

  • Affinität zu moderner Beratungsinfrastruktur und digitalen Prozessen

Wer Sie sind

Sie haben eine etablierte Karriere im Wealth Management. Sie verdienen gut, Sie sind nicht in Eile. Aber Sie spüren — vielleicht schon länger — dass der nächste Schritt nicht ein weiterer Wechsel zwischen Banken sein sollte. Sie wollen Verantwortung übernehmen, gestalten, mitbesitzen.

Sie verstehen, dass die operative Führung eines unabhängigen Vermögensverwalters etwas anderes ist als eine Direktorenrolle in einer Grossbank. Es ist näher am Mandanten, näher am Unternehmen, näher an der eigenen Verantwortung. Genau das suchen Sie — und Sie wissen, dass die Kombination aus etabliertem Institut und moderner Plattform genau der Hebel ist, der diese Rolle in den nächsten Jahren so wirkungsvoll macht.

Über Thrivo

Thrivo Wealth Partners AG ist eine Schweizer Holding-Gesellschaft mit Sitz in Zug. Unser Modell: Beteiligung an inhabergeführten Vermögensverwaltern, Orchestrierung der Nachfolge, geteilte Technologieinfrastruktur. Wir sind langfristiger Partner für zukunftsfähige Vermögensverwalter im DACH-Raum.

Das Team

Hinter Thrivo steht ein Team, das diesen Markt von verschiedenen Seiten kennt. Christopher Kraft hat als Investmentbanker bei Perella Weinberg Partners und in europäischen Wealth-Plattformen etliche Übergaben in der Vermögensverwaltung begleitet. Felix Lobkowicz hat fünf Unternehmen gegründet — eines bis zum Börsengang — und baut nun ThrivoOS, die Infrastrukturplattform die das Modell trägt. Finn Weise verantwortet Kapital und Governance: über eine Dekade Erfahrung im Aufbau von FinTechs und Finanzplattformen, zuvor bei Morgan Stanley und europäischen VC-Fonds. Im Verwaltungsrat sitzt Sebastian Henrichs, ehemaliger CEO der FNZ Bank Deutschland — der führenden Wealth-Plattform der Branche.

Hinter Thrivo

Hinter Thrivo steht ein Kreis von Investoren aus der Finanz- und FinTech-Welt — erfahrene Unternehmer, Operator und Family Offices, die diesen Markt verstehen und langfristig denken. Klassisches Private Equity haben wir bewusst ausgeschlossen. Eine Plattform, die Unternehmern Langfristigkeit verspricht, kann nicht selbst kurzfristig Rendite optimieren.

Wie es weitergeht

Wenn Sie sich angesprochen fühlen, lassen Sie uns ein vertrauliches Erstgespräch führen. Wir lernen einander kennen, hören Ihre Geschichte, verstehen Ihre Vorstellungen — und Sie verstehen, wie wir arbeiten.

Wenn das Gespräch zu einem Ergebnis führt, werden Sie Teil unseres Nachfolgekreises. Sobald eine konkrete Konstellation entsteht, die zu Ihrem Profil passt, kommen wir gezielt auf Sie zu — mit Details zum jeweiligen Institut, zur Region, zum Inhaber und zur Übergangsstruktur.

Aktive Suche, regelmässige Kontaktpflege und vollständige Vertraulichkeit sind selbstverständlich. Sie behalten jederzeit die volle Kontrolle darüber, ob und wie ein konkreter Kontakt zustande kommt.

Erstkontakt erfolgt direkt — eine kurze Nachricht mit Ihrem Hintergrund genügt. Wir antworten innerhalb von 48 Stunden persönlich.

title: Founding Engineer / Lead Architect
description:
THRIVO WEALTH PARTNERS AG

Founding Engineer / Lead Architect

ThrivoOS · Full-Time · Remote Europe · CET core hours

5–8+ years · Architecture ownership · Equity

About Thrivo

The independent wealth management industry is at an inflection point. AI, regulatory pressure, and a looming succession wave will determine which firms thrive — and which flounder — in the coming decade.

Thrivo Wealth Partners AG is a Swiss holding company based in Zug. Our model: partnering with founder-led independent wealth managers across the DACH region, helping them scale — organically and non-organically — and providing shared technology infrastructure. We are the long-term partner for future-ready wealth managers.

The Team

Christopher Kraft has accompanied numerous IWM transitions as an investment banker at Perella Weinberg Partners and in leading European wealth platforms. Felix Lobkowicz is a repeat founder — five companies, one IPO — and leads product and technology at Thrivo. Finn Weise leads capital and governance with over a decade of experience building fintechs and financial platforms, previously at Morgan Stanley and European VC funds. On the board: Sebastian Henrichs, former CEO of FNZ Bank Germany — the leading wealth platform in the industry.

Behind Thrivo

Thrivo is backed by a circle of investors from the finance and fintech world — experienced operators, entrepreneurs, and family offices who understand this market and think long-term. A platform that promises long-term thinking to founders cannot itself be optimising for short-term returns.

The wealth management market in Germany and Switzerland is digitising — more slowly than other sectors, but with real momentum now. Thrivo is building the technology infrastructure that underpins this transformation: a platform for founder-led wealth managers that deploys compliance automation, AI-assisted processes, and modern data architecture in a way that until now has only been available to large institutions.

ThrivoOS is not another fintech dashboard. It is the operating system for a growing group of partner firms collectively managing several billion AUM. You build this — as the first technical full-time hire and the engineering lead.

The Role

You own the technical leadership of ThrivoOS. You set the architecture, coordinate the freelance senior engineer, and are the engineering constant in a project that bridges complex regulatory requirements — MiFID II, WpHG, BaFin — with modern AI infrastructure.

You work directly with Felix Lobkowicz (CTO-in-function) on product vision and technical direction. The most important architectural decisions are yours. The architecture and stack have not been finalised — you will define them together with Felix and Tech advisors based on your experience and what is right for the platform.

This is one of the few roles in DACH fintech where technical depth, genuine entrepreneurial ownership, and real equity participation come together.

What you own

Architecture & Infrastructure

– Design and build an event-sourced backend architecture — the structural foundation for regulatory-grade auditability under MiFID II and BaFin requirements

– Multi-tenant data architecture: one platform, many partner firms, strict data isolation and RBAC

– Batch data ingest pipeline from partner firm systems (custodian banks, PMS) — the Phase 1 data foundation

– Cloud infrastructure on AWS (Frankfurt region) — we use hyperscaler-grade tooling from day one

Workflows & AI

– Advisory workflow engine — regulated advisory processes as structured, automated flows with compliance write-back (Jahresgespräch, KYC/AML as Phase 1 scope)

– AI integration: automated meeting briefings, Gesprächsprotokoll generation, and document assembly for advisors via Gemini/RAG pipeline

– Compliance infrastructure: PII anonymisation before any LLM call, encryption at rest, consent management — structural, not bolt-on

Team & culture

– Coordinate the freelance senior full-stack engineer: architectural decisions, code quality, mutual peer review

– Technical point of contact for the product advisor and design partner advisors during pilot deployment

– Set the engineering culture from day one — we use agentic coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) as standard. We cover the cost.

What Thrivo offers

Real equity participation

Thrivo offers a VSOP participation in the Holding. Structure and terms in conversation.

Ownership from day one

As the founding engineer, you set architecture standards and engineering practices the team will carry for years. You are not executing tickets — you are building the platform.

First-class team

Direct collaboration with Felix Lobkowicz (5 consumer companies founded, one through IPO), Christopher Kraft (Perella Weinberg Partners, 50+ IWM transactions), Finn Weise (Morgan Stanley, VC) and Sebastian Henrichs (former CEO FNZ Bank Germany).

Compensation

We offer a competitive base salary and a meaningful VSOP participation in the Holding. Structure and exact terms in conversation.

What you bring

Requirements

– 5–8+ years of backend engineering in production systems — the right profile depends on depth of architecture experience, not years alone

– Event Sourcing and CQRS in practice — you have built it, not just read about it

– Domain-Driven Design — bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events

– PostgreSQL — schema design, query optimisation, pgvector

– AWS or comparable hyperscaler — production deployment, IAM, VPC, managed services

– Experience in regulated environments — fintech, banking, or insurance

– Senior enough to make architectural decisions independently and coordinate a freelance engineer

– CET timezone — daily overlap for peer review and fast alignment is required

What interests us additionally

– Go, TypeScript, or Java — we care about architecture patterns (Event Sourcing, CQRS, DDD), not the language on your CV. Experience with Go or willingness to work in Go is a plus.

– Familiarity with MiFID II, WpIG, or FINMA regulatory requirements

– Experience with graph-based workflow engines or saga patterns

– German is a plus, not a requirement

Who you are

You have proven you can build complex systems. But you are not looking for the next job at a scale-up with 200 engineers where your work disappears into a microservice pipeline. You want to set the architecture, own the platform, and know that what you build is in production and making a real difference.

An early stage does not put you off — it attracts you, because you know the most important decisions are being made now. And you understand that equity in a platform that is positioning to be the market leader in a structurally underserved segment can be worth more than the next salary band.

title: Product Manager Foundations (m/f/d)
description:
ABOUT US

Unzer is a leading European fintech company with a mission to simplify international payments for e-commerce and retail businesses. Our brand was formed from 13 companies that now contribute to building a unique product covering the entire payment flow.  
 
At Unzer, we are driven by the belief that customers should enjoy a seamless shopping experience, no matter where they choose to shop. We are a team of over 750 experts from 70 different nationalities, dedicated to creating a state-of-the-art unified commerce platform. Our goal is to enable businesses to delight their customers with a seamless payment experience.  
 
Whether you're a tech enthusiast, payment expert, or dedicated support professional, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about making a difference.  
  
Our offices: We are based across Austria, Denmark, Germany, and Luxembourg with a HQ in Berlin.

ABOUT THE TEAM

As a Product Manager at Unzer, your mission is to deliver product value. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the organization, analyze customer feedback, and serve as the subject-matter expert in your domain. Your focus will be to translate insights into actionable specifications and guide product development within your team to ensure the on-time delivery of real, measurable impact that supports company goals. 
 
You will lead platform-wide initiatives in our Foundations group. The team owns the core components of UnzerOne – a modern platform enabling seamless unified commerce solutions for our merchants and fully automated end-to-end (onboarding to settlement) flows to empower our internal stakeholders. 

What your work will look like:

  • Merchant journey: Establish a deep understanding of our merchants’ journey throughout the Unzer platform, from onboarding to settlement, opportunities and pain-points.

  • Manage and Deliver the Product Roadmap: Maintain and own the product roadmap for your area of responsibility, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and on-time delivery of product enhancements and features. 

  • Own Product Initiatives: Plan and execute product initiatives end to end, demonstrating full product ownership and autonomy. 
  • KPI Definition & Performance Tracking: Define and track KPIs to measure product success and drive continuous improvement. 
  • Solve Complex Challenges: Proactively resolve complex challenges across varied product contexts by in-depth analysis from technical and business perspectives and focusing teams on delivering solutions. 

    • Manage Communication and Collaboration: Enable collaboration within your team and communication with stakeholders outside your team, ensuring a shared understanding and effective product delivery. 


What you need to be successful in this role:
  • 3+ years’ product management experience in Tech, ideally in Payments on billing and settlement solutions - a plus if gained within a financially regulated company. 
  • You are skilled at planning, driving, and monitoring product development to meet objectives in high quality and on time. 
  • Your decisions are informed by data, and you are experienced with investigating and resolving a broad range of complex issues in the technology space. 
  • You facilitate collaboration and knowledge sharing within cross-functional teams, engaging stakeholders and ensuring user or customer needs are met. 
  • You communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences, comfortably explaining complex concepts, gaining insights and supporting decision-making. 
  • You bring creativity and an improvement mindset, proposing new solutions, encouraging team enhancements, and implementing changes. 
  • You demonstrate leadership and adaptability by embracing change and actively promoting new technologies and the use of AI in daily work. 

What’s next?
  • Does it sound exciting? -  Apply with your CV in English. Please don’t shy away if you don’t meet all the requirements! We’re looking forward to meeting you.  
  • The interview process includes: a 30min intro call with a TA Partner, a 60-min Hiring Manager interview, a 60-min skills assessment call with the team and an executive interview, 30 min. Please note the process might alter depending on our team’s availability. 
    • WHAT'S IN THERE FOR YOU :
     
    🏡 Work from home up to 60% of the time. We want you to keep your work-life balance. 
    🚲 Mobility support, whether you choose Swapfiets, Jobrad, or a Deutschlandticket - we've got you covered. 
    🫴 Explore counseling assistance, be it for professional or personal matters, through our associated platform. 
    💰 Pension scheme, we want to give back and help you secure your future. 
    🏖️ 15 days a year to work from your desired destination within the EU.
    🕟 Flexible working hours – helping you balance work and life
    📗 Learning budget of 1000 euros per year – you can develop your passions with us. 
    🎉 Enjoy some fun moments with your coworkers – we throw a company party once a year and host several team events! 
     
    We are committed to protecting your personal data. Please find our applicant privacy information here.

SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. — we invite you to be part of the solution!

About the role

As General Counsel, you will lead SoSafe's legal team of lawyers and act as the primary legal advisor to the leadership team. You will own the full legal function, from commercial contracting and data protection to corporate governance and regulatory risk, while acting as a true business partner to Sales, Product, and Information Security. You will also be responsible for all Company Risk and Compliance matters. This is a hands-on, high visibility role for someone who wants to shape legal strategy at a scaling SaaS business, not just execute on it.

What you'll do

Lead the legal team

  • Manage and coach a team of 3 lawyers, setting clear priorities and fairly distributing work across the team

  • Build a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing and constructive feedback within the team

  • Support the professional development of each team member and plan for the team's growth as the business scales

Own legal strategy and governance

  • Set the legal team's strategy and goals in line with SoSafe's broader company objectives

  • Elevate on the market’s transition into AI and its application in the legal area

  • Oversee all core legal functions: corporate governance, contracts, compliance and regulatory risk management

  • Provide legal advice and risk assessment across the business, acting as the final point of escalation on legal matters

  • Ensure efficient internal processes and policies are in place and consistently followed

  • Monitor changes in the legislative and regulatory environment across Germany, Austria and Switzerland (and EU wide, e.g. GDPR, NIS2, EU AI Act) and translate these into practical guidance for the business

Partner with the business

  • Act as a strategic partner to Sales, helping the team sell faster by supporting quoting, offer and contracting processes

  • Partner closely with Information Security on cybersecurity related legal and regulatory matters

  • Build strong working relationships across departments, making legal an enabler rather than a blocker

  • Manage the relationship and information flow between our external DPO and internal teams

  • Coordinate and manage external counsel where needed

What you bring

Experience

  • 8+ years post-qualification experience, including 3-5 years in a commercial or contracting environment

  • Proven experience leading and developing a team

  • Experience in SaaS or another technology business, with a solid understanding of technical and commercial dynamics

  • Strong track record supporting Sales teams and commercial deal cycles

  • Deep data protection law expertise

  • Nice to have: experience in cybersecurity, working alongside Information Security teams, exposure to intellectual property law, and experience working with distributed/remote teams

  • 2nd German State Examination (Volljurist)

  • Fluent in German and English (written and spoken)

How you work

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate legal concepts into practical guidance for non lawyers

  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills

  • Pragmatic, business oriented and hands on, comfortable working under pressure and to deadlines

  • Well organized, detail conscious, and able to manage time and priorities independently

  • Discreet and trustworthy when handling confidential information

  • Comfortable working cross functionally in an interdisciplinary, fast paced environment

What we offer

  • 33 days paid time off (PTO)

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts

  • Parental leave

  • Individual Development Budget: a personal yearly budget to support your growth

  • Wellness Benefit

  • Healthcare and pension plans, availability varies by region

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet ups

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample—you’ll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

doinstruct builds software that helps organizations train and enable their frontline teams, the people in factories, logistics, and service environments who are hardest to reach with conventional L&D. Our customers are manufacturers, industrial operators, and traditional enterprises.

As a key part of our marketing team, you’ll get to flex your strategic, research, and creative skills writing and creating content with two specific goals: Educate our audience (Thought leadership) and convert them (Acquisition). You own both end-to-end.

You will create high-value content in the form of blog articles, case studies, landing page copy and white papers, collaborating closely with internal subject matter experts. For shoots and videos, you’ll use your storytelling super powers to develop concepts, and manage external production partners.

AI is an expected part of your workflow. You leverage the speed and efficiency technology affords with the taste only humans possess to create credible content worth reading.

If you have a journalistic curiosity, understand B2B audiences, and know how to build a content engine from the ground up — let’s talk!


🎯 What you'll own

  • Translate frontline realities, industry insights, trends, analysis and product communication into content that resonates with buyers who don't live in generic SaaS marketing.

  • Plan and produce content across formats ( website, blog, video, social) that performs in both traditional search and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, and adjust based on what you’ve measured.

  • Use AI tools as your default production layer: drafting, repurposing, ideation, research, so you can ship more, faster, without sacrificing quality.

  • You're fluent in German, comfortable writing and speaking it professionally. You’re also comfortable collaborating, presenting, and working at a professional proficiency in English.

  • You’ve already restructured how you work around AI — whether that's tracking AI visibility with something like Profound or Peec AI, producing multilingual content with tools like ElevenLabs or HeyGen, or researching with Perplexity instead of defaulting to Google.   • Bonus, not a requirement: you've worked with or around frontline, industrial, or blue-collar audiences and understand operator priorities.

🤩 What's different here

You're not maintaining an existing content machine; you're bringing a new brand strategy to life; experimenting; and building a content function. That means real ambiguity, but also a chance to have outsized impact on a rapidly scaling business.

🚀 Why doinstruct

  • 400+ customers, Series A funded, below 2% churn. The product is a genuine must-have, which gives you real stories to tell.

  • You're joining a GTM org that's still forming its shape, so what you build sticks.

📈 What success looks like

3 months You've got a content production rhythm running across formats, you understand our frontline buyer personas firsthand, and you’re identifying opportunities.

6 months Content you've produced is showing up in AI answer engines for queries that matter to us, and you can point to the pipeline it's driving. You’ve established strong partnerships with stakeholders both internally and externally.

12 months There's a repeatable content engine that treats AI answer engines as a first-class channel alongside traditional search. Content is having a measurable impact on revenue.

title: Fördermittel- und FinanzierungsexpertIn für KMU-Nachfolge I Vollzeit I ab 01.09.2026
description:
Du liest Förderrichtlinien freiwillig bis zum Ende und kannst aus komplexen Förderbedingungen verständliche Orientierung für Unternehmen machen?

Bei uns übernimmst du keinen bestehenden Fachbereich, sondern baust das Themenfeld Förderung und Finanzierung für Unternehmensnachfolge selbst auf. Gemeinsam mit der Projektleitung entwickelst du die fachliche Ausrichtung und entscheidest, welche Förder- und Finanzierungsfragen wir aufgreifen und wie daraus verlässliche Informationsangebote entstehen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserer Finanz- und M&A-Expertise zusammen und bringst dein Wissen selbst in Workshops und Veranstaltungen ein.

Worum es dabei geht: Jedes Jahr stehen Zehntausende kleine und mittlere Unternehmen in Deutschland vor der Nachfolgefrage. Bleibt sie ungelöst, verschwinden Betriebe, Arbeitsplätze, Wissen und regionale Wertschöpfung. Wir wollen dazu beitragen, dieses Rückgrat der deutschen Wirtschaft zu erhalten und Betriebe mit verständlichen Informationsangeboten und praxisnahen Veranstaltungen dabei unterstützen, Unternehmensnachfolgen erfolgreich vorzubereiten und umzusetzen.

Über uns: NDF ist die auf Fördermittel spezialisierte Marke der Key Progress Makers Advisory GmbH. Wir arbeiten vor allem mit Startups und innovativen Unternehmen, die neue Produkte, Technologien oder Geschäftsmodelle entwickeln und dafür passende Finanzierungsmöglichkeiten suchen. Wir helfen ihnen, Förderpotenziale zu erkennen und anspruchsvolle Vorhaben so zu strukturieren, dass aus einer Idee ein tragfähiges Projekt werden kann. Diese Erfahrung bringen wir nun in ein eigenes öffentlich gefördertes Projekt rund um das Thema Unternehmensnachfolge ein.

Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst Workshops, Informationsangebote und digitale Orientierungshilfen zu Förderung und Finanzierung bei Unternehmensnachfolgen
  • Du vermittelst komplexe Förder- und Finanzierungsthemen verständlich in Workshops, Veranstaltungen und Fachformaten
  • Du recherchierst und analysierst Zuschüsse, Förderdarlehen, Bürgschaften, Garantien und weitere öffentliche Finanzierungsinstrumente für Unternehmensnachfolgen, Investitionen und betriebliche Transformationen
  • Du entwickelst Inhalte für die Projektwebsite, die digitale Plattform und weitere öffentlich zugängliche Informationsformate
  • Du arbeitest eng mit der Fachverantwortung für Finanzierung und M&A zusammen und zeigst, wie öffentliche und private Finanzierungsbausteine grundsätzlich zusammenspielen können

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens drei Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit Förderprogrammen oder öffentlichen Finanzierungsinstrumenten
  • Fundiertes betriebswirtschaftliches und finanzielles Verständnis
  • Erfahrung in der erfolgreichen Beantragung und Umsetzung öffentlicher Fördervorhaben für mittelständische Unternehmen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Innovation, Digitalisierung, Energieeffizienz und energetische Sanierung
  • Die Fähigkeit, Förderbedingungen eigenständig zu recherchieren, zu prüfen, einzuordnen und komplexe Finanzthemen verständlich und praxisnah zu vermitteln
  • Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Durchführung von Workshops, Informationsformaten oder fachlichen Veranstaltungen
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und eine sichere professionelle Kommunikation
  • Eine strukturierte, gewissenhafte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise
  • Einen reflektierten Umgang mit digitalen Recherchewerkzeugen, Automatisierung und KI

Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist für uns nicht entscheidend. Uns interessiert, mit welchen Förder- und Finanzierungsthemen du bereits gearbeitet hast, welche Verantwortung du dabei selbst übernommen hast und wie du zu belastbaren Ergebnissen gekommen bist. Entscheidend ist für uns außerdem, dass du mit Eigeninitiative und echtem Gestaltungswillen an neue Fragestellungen herangehst.

Passende Erfahrungen kannst du beispielsweise aus einer Förderbank, Bürgschaftsbank, Wirtschaftsförderung, Bank, Beratung oder dem Fördermittelmanagement mitbringen. Wichtig ist nicht, dass du jedes Förderprogramm auswendig kennst. Du solltest wissen, wie du relevante Instrumente findest, ihre Voraussetzungen zuverlässig prüfst und die Ergebnisse für Menschen ohne Fördermittelhintergrund verständlich aufbereitest.

Benefits

  • Die Möglichkeit, ein neues Projekt von Beginn an mitzugestalten und eigene Ideen umzusetzen
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Projektleitung und kurze Abstimmungswege
  • Ein interdisziplinäres Team mit Expertise aus den Bereichen Unternehmensnachfolge, Startups und Finanzierung
  • Mobiles Arbeiten mit gemeinsamer Präsenz in Berlin, abgestimmt auf Projektphase und Veranstaltungskalender
  • Gelegentliche bundesweite Reisen sowie einzelne Abendtermine, die frühzeitig geplant und zeitlich ausgeglichen werden
  • Eine Arbeitskultur, in der wir Prioritäten realistisch setzen, Mehrarbeit ausgleichen und Schwierigkeiten früh ansprechen
  • Die Perspektive, auch nach der dreijährigen Projektlaufzeit gemeinsam weiterzuarbeiten und zusätzliche fachliche Verantwortung zu übernehmen

Die Rolle passt zu dir, wenn …

title: Product Engineering Tech Lead
description:
TL;DR

We are hiring a Product Engineering Tech Lead to own the layer that runs our customers' AI applications: serverless, durable, streaming execution, and the observability that proves it works. You sit where backend engineering, platform operations, and product meet. You scale this platform to enterprise grade, push it into new territory like long running autonomous agents, lead the team that builds it, and own the result end to end. This is a builder role with a founder mindset, not a maintainer role.

Why deepset

At deepset, we’re on a mission to make custom AI solutions accessible to every organization. With Haystack, thousands of developers build advanced LLM applications every day, while our enterprise AI Platform helps companies turn large language models into business value. You’ll collaborate with top-tier tech talent, tackle meaningful challenges, and help transform complex AI into solutions that are simple, powerful, and ready for the real world.

What you will do

  • Own the serverless execution platform. Pipelines and agents need to run fast, reliably, and concurrently at enterprise scale, and they need to behave identically whether invoked serverless or running as a deployed service. You'll architect the execution layer that makes that true, including the durability work (surviving node evictions, spot terminations, rolling deploys) needed to keep long-running agents alive for hours, not seconds.

  • Own streaming and long-lived connections. Conversational and agentic workloads here are long-lived, not simple request/responses. You'll own how those connections behave under pressure: backpressure, graceful shutdown, reconnects, for both end users and API clients.

  • Lead the team and the architecture. Set technical direction, make the hard tradeoffs, and translate product strategy into a system that holds up under enterprise load. You stay hands-on on the problems that matter most, even as your day-to-day coding share shifts over time.

  • Make reliability provable. Own observability and metering: tracing, alerting, per-customer cost and usage visibility, so the platform's reliability isn't just a claim, it's something you can show a customer. You'll also own on-call and incident response, closing the loop between what you build and what you operate.

What you bring to the team

  • Builder and founder mindset. You have started things, shipped them, and lived with the consequences. You think about what is next, not only about fixing what is in front of you. Startup or founder experience is a strong signal here.

  • You have built and operated systems on Kubernetes in production, and you are comfortable working from the ground up. This role is not about owning one slice of an existing system, or only operating infrastructure someone else designed. It is product work: building something new and owning the outcome.

  • Durable execution experience. You have worked with durable, fault tolerant execution: retries, failover, durable state, and human in the loop. You understand the failure modes, not just the happy path.

  • Serverless and function platforms at scale. Knative, KEDA, OpenFaaS, Fission, or similar. You know scale to zero, warm pools, cold start tradeoffs, and per request isolation.

  • Streaming and long running workloads. Server sent events or websockets, long lived connections, and the operational reality of keeping them alive through deploys and node churn. Agentic or AI workloads are a plus.

  • Operator instinct. Observability, alerting, service levels, and incident response are second nature. You hold the platform to a production grade standard because it has to work reliably for real customers.

  • You can lead a team and connect strategy to robust architecture. You make the technical direction legible to the rest of the team and to the business.

  • Comfortable in Python and with infrastructure as code (for example Terraform) in a cloud native stack.

Nice to have

  • Built Kubernetes operators or controllers, or automated deployments as a system rather than a script.

  • Taken a platform from zero to one all the way to production grade ownership.

  • Open source contribution or maintenance background.

  • Exposure to B2B SaaS, LLM, or agent infrastructure.

  • 30 days vacation + extra days for family sick leave

Founded in 2018, deepset builds open and enterprise-grade tools that help teams build AI with purpose. From Haystack, our open-source framework, to the Haystack Enterprise Platform, we give developers and organizations the building blocks to solve complex, high impact challenges with AI with full control, transparency, and sovereignty. title: Senior Sales Executive Swiss Markets - Munich
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we’re on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We’re trusted by more than 10,000 companies worldwide, including Wise, On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we’re tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we’re driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you’re excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we’d love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We seek an ambitious and motivated candidate to join as a Senior Sales Executive DACH and support the Sales team. In this role, you will report to the Sales Manager and be instrumental in achieving our ambitious goals within the Swiss Market.

Ultimately, you’ll help us meet and surpass business expectations and contribute to our company’s rapid growth. The ideal person has a pioneering mindset, is hungry, perseverant, and focused, and is not afraid to hit the phone to engage with new customers.

We’ll value someone with a curious mind who is interested in bringing their great Perk experience to a new role. Perfect for a person who is looking to have a significant impact on a scaling sales organization.

What You’ll Do

  • Focus on mid to large enterprise companies (250 - 5000+ employees) headquartered in Switzerland

  • Take on additional responsibility within the team, identify and take ownership and drive projects that bring value to the wider business:

  • Generate new clients for our outstanding travel and spend technology

  • Own the entire sales process from the first touchpoint, present product demos to potential clients, negotiate and do the follow-up until closing the deal;

  • Understand the needs of our target prospects and articulate the value that Perk provides. Follow the entire sales cycle;

  • Stay up-to-date with new features and product launches;

  • Help define and establish best practices together with the broader team;

  • Monitor and report on sales performance analytics and forecasts;

  • Mastering to consult conservative clients into digital opportunities;

  • Owning the conversations between C level stakeholders in finance, procurement, IT, and travel management;

  • Evaluate the existing infrastructure of the clients and consult the individual SaaS solutions;

  • Suggest innovative upsell / partner ideas to increase sales and improve customer experience.

What We’re Looking For

  • Being a native German speaker and fluent in English is a must;

  • Fluency in French is a plus

  • Possess excellent communication, presentation, and public speaking skills;

  • Be hungry and ambitious, yet ethical and sound;

  • Be able to work as an individual contributor, but remember you are part of a team;

  • Be a customer-centric mindset.

What We Offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 30 mins Virtual or IRL if possible

  • Assessment Interview - 60mins - In-person Interview

  • Values Interview - 30mins virtual

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.
